description: This file defines an internal class 'Extension' in the AWS CRT namespace that manages the forwarding of method calls to the awscrt PHP extension functions. It checks if the extension is loaded upon instantiation and forwards method calls dynamically.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: A final class that forwards calls to the awscrt PHP extension, ensuring the extension is loaded and routing calls dynamically.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that throws an exception if the awscrt extension is not loaded.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method that forwards method calls to the extension functions with the same name.
